title: Latency-optimized reranker with adaptive early-exit profiles
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description: Introduce an adaptive early-exit mechanism in the neural reranker to reduce tail latency for short deadlines while preserving ranking quality for high-confidence queries. The feature should be pluggable (config flag + per-route profile) and compatible with existing batching and KV-cache behavior. Key constraints: maintain <=0.5% nDCG drop on benchmark prompt sets, p95 latency improvement >= 30% under production-like microbatching, no user-visible errors during fallback. Must be safe to roll out via canary and include metrics for confidence threshold, exit layer distribution, and accuracy regression.
acceptance_criteria: p95 latency improvement >=30% for rerank route under synthetic load that matches production request mix
p99 latency improvement >=15% without increasing CPU/GPU utilization beyond 8% relative to baseline
nDCG@10 drop <= 0.5% on our standard rerank eval suite (curated queries + negative sampling)
Feature is configurable per-route and enabled via rollout in console with telemetry visible in rerank dashboard
Graceful fallback to full model scoring on confidence metric failure or if microbatching constraints prevent early-exit
benchmarks: Draft patch (conf threshold=0.85): p95 96ms, p99 265ms, nDCG@10 0.869
Optimized microbatch path + early-exit heuristics: p95 88ms, p99 240ms, nDCG@10 0.870
updates: 2025-02-14 - Created ticket. Initial proposal: add confidence head after transformer layer 8 and layerwise budgeted scoring to allow early returns for high-confidence queries.

2025-02-18 - Spike complete: implemented prototype in runtime branch 'early-exit-spike'. Verified correctness on unit tests and small integration harness. Observed 30-40% p95 gains on short sequences.
2025-02-21 - Design review with PM and Research. Decision: use sigmoid confidence head + temperature calibration instead of max-logit heuristic. Requested added telemetry for per-layer exit counts.

2025-02-26 - Integrated early-exit decision into continuous batching pipeline. Added token-budget-aware microbatch splitter to avoid long requests blocking exits. Initial load tests show regressions at high concurrency; investigating KV cache interaction.

2025-03-01 - PR #7146 opened with runtime changes. Perf engineer notes: need to add adaptive timeout hook in scheduler so that a request with an early-exit profile can be preempted for final-scoring when deadline passes.

2025-03-03 - Addressed review comments: added unit tests for fallback path, added metrics for 'early_exit_success' and 'early_exit_confidence'. Preparing canary config in console PR #1892. Next: run canary on low-traffic tenant and collect A/B evals.
rollback_plan: If p99 latency or nDCG regressions exceed thresholds during canary, automatically disable early-exit flag for the affected tenant via rollout control. Revert runtime change if telemetry indicates increased error rate >0.1% or memory footprint increase >10%.
notes_for_QA: Run synthetic traffic mix (short-query heavy + long-query tail) with and without KV cache warm. Validate metrics: early_exit_rate, avg_exit_layer, nDCG@10, per-request latency distribution. Ensure no tokenization edge-cases cause early exits on truncated prompts.
next_steps: Spin up canary on 3 low-traffic tenants and collect 48h of telemetry
Run full rerank eval suite and compare nDCG by query segment
Iterate on calibration curve to move operating point for p95 vs quality tradeoff
Prepare rollout guide for Console with recommended profiles and observability dashboard widgets
